extracted_songs.song_name: Bouncing, Bouncing, Baby on My Knee
extracted_songs.lyrics:
Bouncing, Bouncing
Bounce baby
Baby on my knee
Bouncing, Bouncing
One, Two, Three
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce baby. Tickle/Lift/Slide baby down legs on 3. Additional Verses: Clapping, Clapping... / Rocking, Rocking...

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Toast in the toaster,
Getting very hot,
Tick Tock Tick Tock,
Up you pop!
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce baby. Rock baby side to side. Lift baby off lap and give little swing.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Chop, Chop, Choppity Chop
Cut off the bottoms
And cut of the top
And what there is left
You put it in the pot
Chop, Chop, Choppity Chop
extracted_songs.actions: Chopping motion with baby's hand. Chop hand along feet. Chop hand along forehead. Tickle tummy.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Mix and stir and pat in the pan
I'm going to make a gingerbread man
With a nose so neat,
And a smile so sweet,
Gingerbread shoes on your gingerbread feet
extracted_songs.actions: Chopping motion with baby's hand. Poke nose. Smile. Move baby's feet.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Smooth road, smooth road.
Bumpy road, bumpy road.
Rough road, rough road.
Hole.
extracted_songs.actions: Move baby in circle. Bounce baby. Increase height of bounce. Gently drop baby between legs.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Jelly in the bowl, jelly in the bowl
Wibble, wobble, wibble, wobble,
Jelly in the bowl.

Cookies in the jar, cookies in the jar,
Shake them up, shake them up,
Cookies in the jar.

Candles on the cake, candles on the cake,
Blow them out, blow them out,
Pfft, pfft, pfft!
extracted_songs.actions: Wiggle baby. Wiggle side to side. Wiggle. Bounce baby. Bounce side to side. Bounce. Lean in circle. Rock back and forth. Blow on hair and lie them down.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Rickety, rickety rocking horse,
Over the hills we go,
Rickety rickety rocking horse,
Giddy-up, giddy-up, whoa!
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce baby on knees. Bounce fast and hug.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Pizza, pickle, pumpernickel,
My little baby deserves a tickle!
One for her nose, and one for her toes,
And one for her belly where the hot dog goes!

Zoom, zoom, zoom,
We're going to the moon.
Do you want to take a trip?
Climb aboard my rocket ship!
Zoom, zoom, zoom,
We're going to the moon,
In 5-4-3-2-1
BLAST OFF!
extracted_songs.actions: Rock baby side to side. Bounce baby. Rock baby side to side. Bounce baby. Lift baby into the air.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Trot trot to Boston,
Trot trot to Lynn,
Better watch out,
Or you might...fall...IN!
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce baby on knees. Gently drop baby between legs.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
I'm an airplane (2x)
Flying high (2x)
Watch me tilt this way (2x)
Lean to the left
In the sky, (2x)

Additional Verses:
-Watch me tilt that way
-Watch me do a landing
On the ground
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce baby on knees. Lean to the left. Lean to right. Slide child down knees.

extracted_songs.song_name: Baby, Baby, Smile At Me (Tune: London Bridge)
extracted_songs.lyrics:
Baby, baby, smile at me,
Smile at me, smile at me,
Baby, baby, smile at me,
I love you, my baby.

Additional Verses:
-Baby, baby, clap with me,
-Baby, baby, dance with me,
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce child on knees. Kiss child's cheek. Clap hands. Gently sway child.

extracted_songs.song_name: The Grand Old Duke of York
extracted_songs.lyrics:
The Grand Old Duke of York,
He had ten thousand men.
He marched them up to the top of the hill
And he marched them down again!
And when they're up, they're up.
And when they're down, they're down.
And when they're only half-way up,
They're neither up nor down!
Oh he marched them to the left.
And he marched them to the right.
Then he marched them round and round
Oh what a silly sight!
extracted_songs.actions: Lift baby up in air. Bring baby down to floor. Lift baby up. Bring baby down. Hold baby waist high. Lift baby up and then bring down again. Lean to left. Lean to right. Move in circle.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
Here is the train chugging down the track,
Chuga-chuga Chuga-chuga Chuga-chuga ChOO ChOO
Now it's going forward
Chuga-Chuga Chug
Now it's going backward
Chuga-Chuga Chug
Hear the bell ring
Ding-ding, Ding-ding!
Hear the whistle blow
Choo! Choo!
What a lot of noise it makes
Chuga-chuga Chuga-chuga Chuga-chuga ChOO ChOO
extracted_songs.actions: Move arms like train wheels. Lean forward. Lean backward. Mime ringing a bell. Cup hands around mouth. Cover ears. Move arms like train wheels.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
A hip, a hip, a hippopotamus
Got on, got on, got on a city bus
And all, and all, and all the people said,
"You're squishing us!"

Additional Verses:
A cow, a cow, a cow got on a bus
And all, and all, and all the people said,
"Mooooove over!"
-A sheep ..."Baaaack up!"
-A frog ... "We're hoppy to see you!"
-A cat ... "Your tail's tickling us!"
extracted_songs.actions: Bounce child on knees. Hug baby. Move in circle. Lean back. Big bounces. Tickle child.

extracted_songs.lyrics:
I bounce you here, I bounce you there.
I bounce you, bounce you everywhere!
I hug you here, I hug you there.
I hug you, hug you everywhere!
I tickle you here, I tickle you there,
I tickle you, tickle you everywhere!

notes: No songs from the 45-candidate list appear in this PDF (the candidates are largely Kathy Reid-Naiman and other-library songs not present here). Text extraction was clean; no OCR needed. The PDF ('Baby Bounce Rhymes' from Haverhill Public Library, 2 pages) contains 16 distinct bounce/fingerplay rhymes; per brief rule 3 these were added since they are clearly present with verbatim lyrics and actions. db_ids (62, 1331, 1760, 636) were assigned where the song matched an entry in master missing_lyrics_songs.json; all other present songs have no master entry so db_id: null. Non-candidate additions are the 16 rhymes in extracted_songs. Note: a few master matches (Rickety Rocking Horse, Pizza/Pumpernickel, Zoom Zoom Zoom, On a City Bus/Hippopotamus) are same-song different-source variants of other libraries' masters, hence 'medium' confidence on db_id assignment. PDF spells 'Additional Verses' as 'Additonal' in the On a City Bus section and uses curly quotes/ellipses, preserved verbatim.
